caption: A rich, amber miso ramen broth glistens in a rustic ceramic bowl, topped with tender chashu pork and crisp menma arranged in a delicate, layered mound. Warm wooden tones and soft lighting enhance the inviting, hearty presentation.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches with natural texture.
Chashu pork slice shows pinkish-white meat with browned, slightly crispy edges and a tender, juicy appearance.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and bubbling, cradling noodles and toppings in a warm, inviting swirl.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale beige, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curved shape, showing natural surface striations.
The ramen bowl is a rustic ceramic with earthy brown glaze, textured surface, and slightly uneven rim.
